findings.text: The three new vector_index_filters annotations reach the live graph only through the generated, gitignored imas_codex/graph/schema_context_data.py; a client whose generated module predates these annotations computes the expected property set as {embedding} for the three indexes and its ensure_vector_indexes would drop and recreate them without facility_id, reverting the rebuild this node measured. The main checkout must run build-models --force at integration before the annotated rebuild is trusted.

find_code now coalesces source_file from the denormalized cc.source_file because jt-60sa CodeChunks carry no CODE_EXAMPLE_ID link to a CodeExample, so the CodeExample join yields nothing for that facility; any other consumer relying on that link for source_file still returns nothing for jt-60sa, an ingestion-side gap outside this node's write scope.

justifications.durability: tests pin the in-SEARCH predicate for all three searches and the over-fetch rule (TestSearchSignals/TestSearchDocs/TestFindCode/TestFindSignals), and the widened-cut tests fail when the widening is removed, so the guard is falsifiable; deducted because the three new annotations reach the live graph only through the gitignored generated schema_context_data.py, so a stale client's ensure_vector_indexes would drop and recreate the indexes without facility_id and silently revert the rebuild the node measured.
justifications.evidence: gate at the code head 16d1948fa is 732 passed, 10 skipped, exit 0 against a base of 684 passed, 0 failed (facility-prefilter-sibling-indexes-gate-after5.log / -gate-base.log); live _search_signals and _search_docs return jt-60sa rows at default k=10 (live-search.log) and all four indexes read state=ONLINE properties=['embedding','facility_id'] (index-state.log); four negative controls are real red arms, each EXIT=1 with the named test failing.
justifications.fit: Matches the §12 pattern the plan names: annotation on the embedding slot, facility predicate inside SEARCH, comment stating the mechanism rather than the plan, conventional two-part commits; the code-example except is narrowed to (ClientError, DatabaseError) as §3 did for the fulltext branches.
justifications.goal_fidelity: §16's four claims are all delivered: facility.yaml registers vector_index_filters on the FacilitySignal/WikiChunk/CodeExample embedding slots (lines 2314, 3823, 3309), search_tools.py renders the facility predicate inside SEARCH for _vector_search_signals/_vector_search_wiki_chunks/_vector_search_code_examples, domain_queries.py moves _find_signals_semantic/_find_wiki_semantic/find_code onto the facility_id property pre-filter with no AT_FACILITY post-filter, and the over-fetch is retained only beside a non-facility post-filter.
justifications.reuse: One facility-filter mechanism now covers every index carrying facility_id — search_tools.py and domain_queries.py both pre-filter on the registered property, the redundant CodeFile join in find_code is retired rather than paralleled, and the pool of model labels not annotated (_find_data_nodes_semantic) is named and left, so no second mechanism was introduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path (facility.yaml, llm/search_tools.py, graph/domain_queries.py, three test files, one evidence fragment) lies inside the declared write_paths; the worktree is clean at HEAD and no path outside the grant was touched.
